questions.stem_text: In an approach-approach conflict, a discernible move in a given direction should

options.A: lead to a return in the opposite direction
options.B: reduce the attractiveness of the outcome approached
options.C: lead to a compromise between the two outcomes
options.D: magnify the conflict in that direction
options.E: create a new conflict in the opposite direction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - lead to a return in the opposite direction

questions.stem_text:
The most common treatment for ADHD is drug treatment using CNS stimulants. In relation to
treatment for ADHD which of the following statements is incorrect?

options.A: For reducing activity levels a higher dose of the stimulant is required.
options.B: Stimulant therapy is only effective for adult ADHD, not for children.
options.C: A higher dose of the treatment leads to severe physical dependency.
options.D: A limitation of stimulant therapy is that not all children improve.
options.E: The treatment does not improve attention span.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - For reducing activity levels a higher dose of the stimulant is required.
